meta.phase: AI visibility / Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) audit
meta.scope: Audit and report only — no code, schema, robots or content changes. Based on the current post-Phase-1/2A/2B/2C/2D build (134 pages).
meta.method: Static analysis of prerendered dist/ HTML + JSON-LD, robots.txt, vercel.json and source components. No external web browsing performed.

scores.note: Technically excellent and content much improved after Phases 1-2D; held back by entity/About misalignment, schema inconsistency across templates, brand-name split, and unverified off-site presence.

current.effect: All crawlers allowed via wildcard, including Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, CCBot.
current.metaRobots: No noindex on any of 134 pages. No nosnippet / max-snippet:0 / max-image-preview restrictions. No X-Robots-Tag headers in vercel.json.
current.cssJsBlocking: None (no Disallow on /assets). Google can render fully.

recommendation.bingbot: Allow (already allowed — also powers Copilot/ChatGPT partial).
recommendation.GPTBot: OPTIONAL. GPTBot is primarily model-training crawl, not live search. Recommend ALLOW for maximum long-term brand presence in LLM knowledge, unless the owner wants to withhold content from training — blocking GPTBot does NOT reduce ChatGPT-search citations (those use OAI-SearchBot/ChatGPT-User). Owner decision.
recommendation.sitemap: Keep referenced (add a second explicit Sitemap line only if a news/image sitemap is added later).
recommendation.action: The wildcard already allows everyone, so nothing is currently blocked. Add EXPLICIT named User-agent blocks so the policy is intentional and auditable, and make a conscious GPTBot decision.

2. Create a single shared LocalBusiness schema constant (name, alternateName [Auto-Cleanse, AutoCleanse], telephone +441803269895, email, url, image + logo, address [standardised], geo, openingHoursSpecification, sameAs [confirmed profiles], priceRange) and emit it consistently on ALL templates (location, vehicle, DPF, core) — ideally with a stable @id for entity consolidation.
